13	 * Six parts:
14	 *   - `root` — outer vertical flex container: the label row above, the swatches row below.

18	 *   - `label` — the label row ("labelContainer" in Figma): the label-group (the two

# PR #81 Review — Hardcoded Values & Styling DRY/Consistency

## Task 1 — Foundation token cross-check (218px, 47px, 72px, 45rem/720px)

**Clean — no defect.** Read `zimmTokens.ts` in full (207 lines, all ~90 CSS-var entries), plus `spacing.ts`, `sizes.ts`, and `gridSystem.ts` (imported into `zimmTokens.ts` as `grid`). Converted every numeric entry to px:
- Named spacing scale: 2/4/8/12/16/20/24/32/40/64/80/128/160
- Numeric `--zimm-scale-NNN` aliases: 1/8/12/16/20/24/**28**/32/40/**44**/**48**/**52**/64/**140**/**180**
- `iconSizes`: 12/16/20/24. `actionSizes`: height 40/52, paddingX 20/32, gap 16. `megaMenuSizes.twoColumnMaxWidth`: **700**.
- `grid.containerPadding`: 32/40. `grid.maxWidth`: `'none'`.

None equal 218, 47, 72, or 720 (45rem) at any conversion. The one near-miss I checked deliberately — `megaMenuSizes.twoColumnMaxWidth` (700px) vs. `BODY_MAX_WIDTH` (720px) — is 20px off and a different design context (mega-menu column vs. gallery lightbox column), so not a real candidate even if it were exact. `overrides/app/theme/foundation/zimmTokens.ts`, `spacing.ts`, `sizes.ts`, `gridSystem.ts`:1-30 each — CONFIRMED, 🔵 (verifies the PR's own audit-allow comments are legitimate, not evasive).

One pre-existing oddity noticed in passing: `overrides/app/components/ui-kits/atoms/zimmColourSwatch/zimmColourSwatch.css.ts:49` (`// audit-allow: 47px × 72px — no foundation token for swatch dimensions`) cites **no Figma node** anywhere in the file, unlike every other raw value this PR touches (720/218/102 all cite a specific node ID). This is pre-existing (untouched by this PR — see diff below), not a new defect, but stands out for contrast against the new circle variant added in this PR, which does cite `40001992:51882`. CONFIRMED, 🔵, ONE-OFF, out of this PR's authorship but worth flagging.

## Task 2 — The hidden magic-number gap (THUMBNAIL_* constants)

`scripts/auditTokenUsage.mjs:57-58`:
```js
const HEX_RE = /#[0-9a-fA-F]{3,8}\b/g;
const UNIT_RE = /\b\d+(?:\.\d+)?(?:rem|em|px)\b/g;
```
Both regexes require a `#` prefix or a `px`/`rem`/`em` suffix. A bare `102`, `204`, `136` (or `720`, `902`, `450` — see below) has neither, so it **cannot** match, structurally, regardless of surrounding context (object literal, function arg, JSX attribute). Confirmed by reading the source directly, not inferred.

**`overrides/app/components/ui-kits/organisms/zimmGalleryOverlay/index.tsx:55,60,63,64`** — `IMAGE_WIDTHS = {..., lg: 720}`, `THUMBNAIL_REQUEST_WIDTH = 204`, `THUMBNAIL_DISPLAY_WIDTH = 102`, `THUMBNAIL_DISPLAY_HEIGHT = 136` are bare unitless numbers expressing real pixel dimensions (fed to `<Image htmlWidth/htmlHeight>` and `resolveDisImageSrc`'s width param) that the audit tool cannot see. A failure scenario: a future Figma update changes the thumbnail to 96px and a developer updates `zimmGalleryOverlay.css.ts:104`'s `'6.375rem'` (which `npm run audit:tokens` would at least surface as a value to sanity-check) but never touches these four constants, since nothing flags them — the DIS request now fetches a mismatched resolution silently. CONFIRMED, 🟡, UNIFORM (same root cause, 4 constants across index.tsx).

Same tool-invisible pattern recurs, unprompted by the task brief, in **`overrides/app/components/ui-kits/organisms/zimmProductGallery/index.tsx:36-37`** — `STACKED_ITEM_WIDTHS = {..., lg: 902}`, `GRID_ITEM_WIDTHS = {..., lg: 450}`. These are single-instance (no second literal copy elsewhere — verified via grep), so lower DRY risk than the 102/720 cases below, but the same detection gap. CONFIRMED, 🔵 (noted for completeness, not escalated since no duplicate exists to drift).

**Answer to (b):** option **(ii)** — within the tool's intended spirit (a hardcoded design dimension a token should back) but invisible to its regex because it's a unitless JS number, not a CSS-shaped string. A fair caveat: `htmlWidth`/`htmlHeight`/a DIS fetch-width argument are HTML-attribute/network-request values, not literal CSS style props — arguably a different value-class than what `overrideStyling.md`'s hierarchy ("never a raw hex/px/rem/em literal in a component file") was written against, so option (i) has partial merit too. Either way, the DRY exposure (Task 3) is real regardless of which label applies.

## Task 3 — 102px (and 720px) typed twice, no shared constant

Confirmed both files/lines as described:
- `overrides/app/components/ui-kits/organisms/zimmGalleryOverlay/zimmGalleryOverlay.css.ts:104` — `width: '6.375rem', // 102px`
- `overrides/app/components/ui-kits/organisms/zimmGalleryOverlay/index.tsx:63` — `const THUMBNAIL_DISPLAY_WIDTH = 102;`, tied together only by prose ("matches `thumbnail`'s own 102px width, zimmGalleryOverlay.css.ts", line 62). `THUMBNAIL_REQUEST_WIDTH = 204` (line 60, documented "2x") and `THUMBNAIL_DISPLAY_HEIGHT = 136` (line 64, documented as the 3:4 ratio) are hand-derived by comment, not computed (`THUMBNAIL_DISPLAY_WIDTH * 2`, etc.) or imported from one source.

A second, identical instance of the exact same anti-pattern, same PR, same component pair: `BODY_MAX_WIDTH = '45rem'; // 720px` (`zimmGalleryOverlay.css.ts:15`) vs. `IMAGE_WIDTHS = {..., lg: 720}` (`index.tsx:55`) — again tied only by a comment ("matches `bodyInner`'s own BODY_MAX_WIDTH exactly (720px)").

Confirmed the codebase's own precedent for this exact situation exists and was **not followed**: `theme/components/footerShared.ts` is the canonical cross-file shared-constant module (breakpoints + `SIZE_COL_NAV`, explicitly for values needed by sibling split-out recipe files). `zimmColourSwatchGroupShared.ts` (`molecules/zimmColourSwatchGroup/`) explicitly follows this precedent — its own doc comment says so verbatim: *"the same shared-module precedent theme/components/footerShared.ts already sets."* Confirmed via `find` that **no equivalent file exists** anywhere in `zimmProductGallery/`, `zimmGalleryOverlay/`, or `zimmMediaTile/` — the only `*Shared.ts` in the entire `ui-kits/` tree is `zimmColourSwatchGroupShared.ts`. The gallery trio had a same-PR sibling example to follow and didn't. `overrides/app/components/ui-kits/organisms/zimmGalleryOverlay/index.tsx:55,60,63,64` + `zimmGalleryOverlay.css.ts:15,104` — CONFIRMED, 🟡, UNIFORM (2 instances: 102px, 720px — same defect class, same file pair, same PR).

**Clean.** Grepped `var(--zimm-color-` across all 3 new/touched recipe files plus the diff portions of the swatch pair:
- `background`/`bg-*`/`opacity-*` tokens → always on `background:` (`zimmMediaTile.css.ts:32`, `zimmGalleryOverlay.css.ts:43,56`). Correct.
- `text-default` → always on `color:` (`zimmGalleryOverlay.css.ts:127`, `zimmColourSwatchGroup.css.ts` labelName). Correct.
- `icon-disabled` → on `color:` (`zimmColourSwatchGroup.css.ts` pageButton `_disabled`) — correct per the task's own stated rule (icon tokens belong on `color:`, since SVG icons resolve fill via `currentColor`).
- `border-focus` → 5 instances (`zimmGalleryOverlay.css.ts:113,131,170`; `zimmProductGallery.css.ts:151,176`) all via `boxShadow: 'inset 0 0 0 var(--zimm-border-width-default) var(--zimm-color-border-focus)'`, not literal `border-color`. Technically a different CSS property than the task's checklist names, but every instance carries the same documented reason (edge-flush controls where an outward `outline` would be clipped by the viewport/tile edge) and the pattern is applied **uniformly**, not ad hoc. Not a mismatch — a deliberate, consistent alternate rendering of the same border-semantic intent. `zimmColourSwatch.css.ts`'s `borderBottom` usage of the same token (both variants) is the "canonical" form on an actual border property, confirming the token choice itself is right; only the delivery mechanism (boxShadow vs. border) differs by necessity.

No file: property: token combination found where the category is actually wrong (e.g., a border token used as text colour, or an icon token used as background). CONFIRMED, 🔵 clean.
